name: Name
pairing_pin:
Enter this PIN on the host:

{pin}
no_hosts: No hosts yet. A host is a PC running MoonDeck Buddy.
cli_not_found:
MoonDeck CLI not found.
Please copy cli.py and the lib/ folder into the cli/ directory.
action_running: An action is already running for this host.
no_mac:
No MAC address set for this host.
Edit the host and add a MAC address to enable Wake.
tray_color_change: Change tray icon color with status
action_failed_hint: Host may be unreachable or Buddy is not responding.
pairing_unreachable_hint: Check that Buddy is running and the port is open.
language_restart: Language changed. Takes effect after a restart.
attribution:
This app uses the MoonDeck CLI by FrogTheFrog.

Thank you for the great work!
cli_download_failed:
Failed to download MoonDeck CLI.
Check your internet connection and try again.
port_invalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
confirm_steam_close:
Really close Steam on '{name}'?

Running games will be closed as well - unsaved progress may be lost.
hibernate_failed_hint: Hibernate may be disabled on the PC (Windows: powercfg /hibernate on).
why_pc_on: Not available: the PC is already on.
why_no_buddy: Not available: Buddy is not reachable.
update_detail: You are using {current}. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
update_failed_detail: No connection or certificate problem – details in the log.
update_failed_no_ca: No system certificate store found (install ca-certificates or set SSL_CERT_FILE) – details in the log.
cli_bundled_missing: The bundled MoonDeck CLI is missing from this AppImage. Wake, shutdown and pairing will not work – please download the AppImage again.
tiles_all_hidden: All tiles are hidden – use ✎ to show them again.
tile_blocked: Not possible: no room there (edge or occupied cell).
tile_moved: There was no room at the old place – the tile is now at the next free cell.
tile_full: No free room left in the grid – hide or shrink another tile first.
tip_template: Ready-made tile layout. Tiles that are not needed are hidden, not deleted.
delete_host_detail: The entry is removed from BuddyRemote. Nothing is changed on the host itself. You can undo this from the notice right afterwards.
tile_reflowed: Other tiles were moved so nothing overlaps.
tile_drop_rejected: No room there (outside the grid or occupied) – the tile went back.
licenses_hint: BuddyRemote includes these components. Pick a component on the left to read its license text.
tip_licenses: Show the license texts of all bundled components (Qt, PyQt6, ICU, SDL2, MoonDeck CLI …)
tile_dup_blocked: Cannot duplicate (no room, or already {n} duplicates).
tile_hidden: Tile hidden – show it again with “Show hidden”.
tip_tiles_auto: Arrange by usage: most used action first and bigger
tiles_auto_default: No usage data yet – default order.
edit_hint: Anything with ⠿ can be moved · tap to edit
tip_edit_done: Finish editing (Esc). All changes are already saved.
tip_conn: Connection settings: name, IP, MAC, port, delete
conn_tiles_hint: You arrange the tiles right in the card: “✎ Edit” in the toolbar (Ctrl+E).
st_warn: PC on, but Buddy does not answer
st_buddy_hint: Is Buddy started on the PC? Check the firewall and the port.
st_auto_off: Automatic check is off (⟳ checks now)
tb_collapse_edit: The bar stays visible while editing.
tb_cannot_hide: The app controls cannot be hidden – only moved and resized.
tb_selected: {name} selected: drag, Ctrl+←/→ or change the size
edit_hint_selected: Size, hide, or arrow keys to move
edit_hint_drag_tile: Drop the tile in this grid only · Esc cancels
edit_hint_drag_tb: Place the icon in the app controls · Esc cancels
edit_hint_drag_card: Place the card in the list · Esc cancels
tip_data_dir: Open the folder with settings and log in the file manager
data_dir_failed: Could not open the data folder
data_dir_failed_hint: Copy the path and open it in the file manager.
